---
title: "how do the optimised values compare with their bounds?"
---

{{< include _model.qmd >}}

```{python}
result_dict = optimize_glider()
sol = result_dict["sol"]
vars_dict = result_dict["vars"]
bounds_dict = result_dict["bounds"]

taper_val = sol.value(vars_dict["taper"])
taper_lb = bounds_dict["taper"][0]
```

**Answer.** Only the taper ratio hits a bound, resting exactly on its lower limit. All other variables optimize strictly to the interior of their ranges.

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

print("| Variable | Value | Lower Bound | Upper Bound |")
print("|---|---|---|---|")
print(f"| Taper | {taper_val:.2f} | {bounds_dict['taper'][0]:.2f} | {bounds_dict['taper'][1]:.2f} |")
print(f"| Root Chord (m) | {sol.value(vars_dict['c_root']):.3f} | {bounds_dict['c_root'][0]:.2f} | {bounds_dict['c_root'][1]:.2f} |")
print(f"| CG X (m) | {sol.value(vars_dict['cg_x']):.3f} | {bounds_dict['cg_x'][0]:.2f} | {bounds_dict['cg_x'][1]:.2f} |")
print(f"| Alpha (°) | {sol.value(vars_dict['alpha']):.1f} | {bounds_dict['alpha'][0]:.0f} | {bounds_dict['alpha'][1]:.0f} |")
print(f"| Velocity (m/s) | {sol.value(vars_dict['V']):.1f} | {bounds_dict['V'][0]:.0f} | {bounds_dict['V'][1]:.0f} |")
print(f"| Gamma (°) | {sol.value(vars_dict['gamma']):.1f} | {bounds_dict['gamma'][0]:.0f} | {bounds_dict['gamma'][1]:.0f} |")
```
